{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–8 (Players Committee PDF slips). It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 8]] and not a GEMP environment.}}
'''Premiere - Original VS8''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] and [[Reflections III]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–8. [[Virtual Set 8 (Original)|Virtual Set 8]] was in play by 25 November 2004, when a Game Players Network post said "After looking at the new V8 cards".<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=5901 Gaffer Gamgee, GPN deck 5901] (Wayback)</ref> The short name '''POVS8''' is used in GEMP importable deck file names.

Wiki decklists use this format when the newest original-era virtual card in the list comes from Virtual Set 8.
